bullets.text: Periyapalayam residents staged a midnight protest over a power cut, and the office should monitor electricity restoration in the area.
College students assaulted a government bus conductor in Avadi after a dispute, and the office should track police action on the matter.
A 44-year-old man from Puzhal was killed after being run over by a truck near Madhavaram, and the office should watch the police investigation.
Two cows and a deer died due to electrocution in the Anuppampattu area near Ponneri, and the office should coordinate safety checks with electricity officials.
A 19-year-old college student and a private firm employee were killed in accidents near Kelambakkam and Poonamallee, and the office should monitor road safety measures.
Vyoma.AI broke ground on a 52 MW AI-ready green data center with liquid cooling in Chennai, and the office should support infrastructure growth.
Swami Sarvapriyananda stated at a Chennai International Centre event that AI lacks human-like individual consciousness, and the office should note the philosophical discussion.

The shift reflects broader global industry trends in digital advertising and artificial intelligence search integration.
